provenance.analysis: Kiki 2026-09-10: *thumb_jump prints `bl %l0` as a far jump when the distance is outside -2048..+2044 (length attribute) and thumb_far_jump_used_p (arm.c:8598) saves lr for it; a bl to a label whose target returns is not emit-able (no call template takes a label_ref, arm.md:5905-6006). Site classification over the 10 regions: 45 intra-owner bl sites, every target block reaches its end without bx lr or pop {pc} (none returns to the bl site); 42 sites are beyond -2048..+2044 measured pc+4-relative in the final layout, 3 sit inside it (0x08027bae -> .L39 at -1886, 0x0808f62a -> .L7 at +2018, 0x080a2a76 -> .L0 at +2008), within the far-jump range, and are unexplained: shorten_branches lengths only grow, so a jump that was ever far keeps a final distance at least as large (Kiki, 2026-09-10) — the attribute-relative distance for those 3 is being derived from the source rules. Reading for the 42: compiler far jumps; for the 3: open. Kiki 2026-09-10, from the source rules: the three in-range sites are cbranchsi4's length-8 conditional far form (b%D .LCB; bl %l3, arm.md:5167/5202) at distances +2016/+2014/-1880 by the compiler's own reference (final.c:930-950), inside the length-6 window; shorten_branches (final.c:1490-1530) shrinks as well as grows, so no fixed point emits length 8 there, and alignment fuzz (final.c:877-903) cannot bridge it. Not derivable; origin open. Site forms over all 45: 26 conditional-skip, 19 plain.
